overall_goal: Tidy up the workspace, wash hands, and monitor the baking cookies

goals.description: Tidy up baking tools and supplies
goals.rationale: The person clears the workspace by putting down spoons and storing the baking paper.
The person closes the oven door and later checks on the progress of the cookies baking inside.
The person washes their hands in the sink, dries them with a tea towel, and hangs the towel back up.
